id: title:ablaszkiewicz:raise weekly digest clickhouse execution ceiling to 120s

review.posthog_relevance: Allows HogQL queries in the weekly digest backend to exceed the 60s default, preventing premature timeout on high-volume 14-day scans.
review.reason: Adds a HogQL execution time constant and its use in HogQL settings, allowing HogQL queries in the weekly digest backend to exceed the 60s default, preventing premature timeout on high-volume 14-day scans.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of high-volume 14-day scans that previously timed out; this is not independently verified by the code, only asserted in the connection description.
